text: I see the children with their comic books on the subway and I think: I built the road they're travelling on. Others collected the tolls.

choices.text: What do you make of Superman?
What do you make of Superman?

text: Superman. Those boys had been carrying that idea around for years. A few months more, and the strongest man in the world would have been working for me.
I'd rather not talk about Superman. Ask me something else.
Batman turned up in Detective Comics in 1939. My title, a year after I'd lost it.
Wonder Woman? I know the name. My grandchildren tell me there's a whole league of them now. Back in my day, one hero per magazine was plenty.
Regrets? I trusted the wrong partner. In the Army, at least, you know which side the enemy is on.

choices.text: What would you tell someone starting a company?

text: If you ever start a company, keep your own books and owe no man more than you can repay by Friday.

choices.text: Thank you, Major. I think that's everything.
